source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A unit using rapid disembark after its **TRANSPORT** made an [Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move) must obey every rule and restriction that bound that **TRANSPORT**.

For instance, if the **TRANSPORT** had to arrive over 8″ from every enemy unit and outside the opponent's deployment zone, so does the disembarking unit.

detail.appliesTo: rapid disembark after the TRANSPORT's ingress move
detail.modelsFollow: the same rules and restrictions as that TRANSPORT
